Results.ReviewText: Easy to use great heat distribution easy to control
Results.Title: Great cooking

Results.ReviewText: It gets hot quickly and doesn't waste propane. The only issue it that it can be challenging to attach the 1lb propane bottle.
Results.Title: WeberQ

Results.ReviewText: Why did I wait so long?  I've had probably 4 or 5 gas grills over the last 20 or so years.  Each one was fine for a year or two but eventually they just fell apart.  Rust was always the issue, even though I'd keep them covered.  A buddy of mine swore by Weber grills and finally I listened to his advice, did my homework and bought a Q1200.  From the get-go I love it. The thing is built like a tank!  It's portable, easy to clean and really simple to use and the grilling is excellent!.
Results.Title: Why did I wait so long?

Results.ReviewText: Grilled steaks at 11200 elev. and got to over 500 degrees in less than 15 minutes.
Results.Title: Quick to 500

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this grill!! It's very well made with cast iron grates which I love. We used it while camping and it was so handy and easy to use. It cooked our hamburgers and sausage perfectly.  I would highly recommend this company Weber is #1 in customer satisfaction.  Thank you for making our anniversary perfect🩷
Results.Title: Perfect grill for a Perfect weekend

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, well thought out design and works great.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for camping. Heats up quickly and maintains steady temperature.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: Finally I was able to afford a Weber. It’s the perfect size and wow what a difference from the other grills I’ve had. Definitely worth the money.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: Works great. Lights right up and constantly cooks the food evenly.
Results.Title: New weber

Results.ReviewText: great for 2 people or when extra cooking space is needed for bigger cookouts. easy to store. heats up nicely and good temp control.
Results.Title: Great all-round grill

Results.ReviewText: Too small to get the food away from the heat for indirect cooking.
Results.Title: Go Big!

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill what can cook steak to hotdogs. Great price through Atkinson outfitters.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Had an issue with my grill not long after purchase, both the vendor and Weber offered great service
Results.Title: Great service

Results.ReviewText: The Best Little Grill ever!! Tiny grill, but does everything
Results.Title: Little Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is cool looking and was easy to set up. Got the propane connected properly, but the flames are barely lit. The grill does get hot after a long time and I have been able to cook, but it is not lighting properly and I'm not sure what to do about that. I'm going to try a different size propane tank. I have looked at the troubleshooting guide and everything seems fine.
Results.Title: Doesn't light well

Results.ReviewText: love it, only wish you had the option to have just one side on at a time.
Results.Title: fantastic grill.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill for my husband for his birthday.  We took it camping and it worked great for chicken, steaks, grilled vegetables and hot dogs. The stand also comes in handy to make it easy to use and I would also recommend buying the griddle skillet to make pancakes.  I would recommend this unit to my friends and family.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Review

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. It is reliable, sturdy and compact. It is my “go to” grill for camping.
Results.Title: Compact yet very capable

Results.ReviewText: This is the second 1200 gas grill that I have purchased.  They do a great job and there are only 2 in our family so it is perfect for us.  Quick and easy to use.  Just went to Yellowstone National Park and took it with us.  Easy to transport.  We love it.
Results.Title: Easy to Use

Results.ReviewText: Excellent "little'" grill. Does everything you would want and cooks food perfectly. Small enough to be relatively portable but big enough to cook for 4 people easily.
Results.Title: Excellent "little" grill.

Results.ReviewText: We bought it about two years ago for a two-person family and occasionally for friends and kids during BBQs, and it has served us very well. Recently, we had an issue with the gas valve, but Weber quickly sent us a new one via FedEx without any hassle. I replaced it today, and it's working great again. Excellent support and service. Good product. I'm not sure what will happen when the warranty runs out, but nothing lasts forever. So far, so good
Results.Title: good product and service

Results.ReviewText: This is a perfect grill for small items or for just 2-3 people.  It’s easy to keep clean and perfect for storing away.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: We have a small patio in an apartment complex. The compact size is great, and the Weber does great job. I t would have been a 5 star, but I have difficulty with the burner going out. Weber has been great helping me to diagnose the trouble but I'm still unable to use my grill.
Results.Title: Weber 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a well built grille that cooks well. I was surprised when it needed a new regulator, but Weber sent me a new one promptly and for free.
Results.Title: High quality. Cooks evenly.

Results.ReviewText: We purchased the Q 1200 to use with our motorhome. We have a full size Weber genesis at home. The Weber quality can't be beat. We have enjoyed many great meals on the road.
Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, design makes it the best little grilling machine and getting any service done with weber is super easy and friendly.
Results.Title: Great Company

Results.ReviewText: Nice compact grill has a mighty fire!  It’s so nice to have a grill that goes from OFF to 400 degrees in just a few minutes.
Results.Title: Like Those BBQ Marks on Your Steak?

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product, we have used Weber grills for years
Results.Title: Best bbq

Results.ReviewText: Love the size, great quality.  Handy for taking on the road.
Results.Title: Love It

Results.ReviewText:
Great little grill and well made. Works great! Wasn’t sure it would heat enough, but it does.  
It heats very well.
Results.Title: This is a great little grill.

Results.ReviewText: Takes longer to heat up than the larger grill we had (so I have to be more patient) but once it’s hot it works great! Probably great to take somewhere because it’s not too heavy, but we got the portable style so we can store it in the garage between uses
Results.Title: Works great!

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is awesome, I had an older Weber a bit larger. I had it for over 20 years. My husband over the years had to replace some parts to keep it going.
This is grill is a very reliable product. This new one now comes with a temp gauge which is very useful. I only buy Weber.
Results.Title: Best Grill ever!

Results.UserLocation: Anytown USA - road trip around the USA
Results.ReviewText: I had an earlier model of this grill and it worked well for a long time.  This grill seems it will also last a long time.  I was disappionted to find that the hooks for BBQ tools were removed from the side tables - the original had them and they were very helpful.  I have a second issue but here the blame lies with me primarily.  I have turn ed the grill on with the side tables still folded inside too many times to remember.  I wish there was a feature which prevented lighting of the grill until the table flaps were extended
Results.Title: High Quality and Convenient size BBQ for our RV

Results.ReviewText: A perfect size for two people…even four! Heats up so quickly and good to have a temperature guage
Results.Title: Portable BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill it’s perfect for small meals for up to four people
Results.Title: Great grill for the price
